title: Shared definitions
description: Reusable data types referenced by every entity schema in the Common Ownership Operating Schema.

Identifier.title: Identifier
Identifier.description: An opaque, stable identifier assigned by the system that holds the record. Identifiers are unique within a data set and carry no meaning of their own.

Date.title: Date
Date.description: A calendar date in ISO 8601 extended format (YYYY-MM-DD).

DateTime.title: DateTime
DateTime.description: A date and time in RFC 3339 format, including a UTC offset (for example 2026-03-14T19:00:00-07:00).

Money.title: Money
Money.description: A monetary amount. The amount is a decimal string to avoid floating-point rounding errors.

amount.description: Decimal amount with up to two fractional digits. Negative values are permitted where the field description allows them.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Only CAD is currently defined.

Address.title: Address
Address.description: A Canadian civic or mailing address.

unitDesignator.description: Unit, suite or apartment designator, if any (for example "1203").

region.description: Province or territory code. Strata records are expected to use BC, but mailing addresses may be elsewhere.

postalCode.description: Canadian postal code in the form A1A 1A1.

StrataPlanNumber.title: StrataPlanNumber
StrataPlanNumber.description: The strata plan number as registered with the Land Title Office: an alphabetic prefix followed by digits (for example EPS1234, LMS567, VIS890, VR12). Normalise to upper case without spaces.

ParcelIdentifier.title: ParcelIdentifier
ParcelIdentifier.description: BC Parcel Identifier (PID) in the form 123-456-789.

Extensions.title: Extensions
Extensions.description: Implementation-specific data that is not part of the standard. Keys must be reverse-domain namespaces owned by the implementer (for example "ca.example.app"), so extensions from different vendors never collide.
